paper_title: Leveraging ChatGPT As Text Annotation Tool For Sentiment Analysis
caption: Accuracy of ChatGPT VS VADER and TextBlob
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy of three sentiment analysis tools—TEXTBLOB, VADER, and ChatGPT—when applied to two types of Twitter data: "Emoji Tweets" and "Overall Tweet and Tweet containing emojis." The vertical axis represents accuracy, ranging from 0.0 to 0.8 with linear increments of 0.2. The horizontal axis categorizes the data into two groups: "Emoji Tweets" on the left and "Overall Tweet and Tweet containing emojis" on the right. Within each group, three bars are displayed side-by-side, corresponding to the three tools, with distinct patterns: TEXTBLOB is represented by a white bar with no fill, VADER by a gray bar with diagonal stripes, and ChatGPT by a solid green bar. For "Emoji Tweets," TEXTBLOB achieves an accuracy of approximately 0.3, VADER reaches about 0.5, and ChatGPT attains roughly 0.7. In the "Overall Tweet and Tweet containing emojis" category, TEXTBLOB’s accuracy drops to around 0.2, VADER remains at approximately 0.5, and ChatGPT maintains its high performance at about 0.7. The bars are not sorted by height within each group, and no visual emphasis such as outlines or annotations is applied to any bar. The chart clearly shows that ChatGPT outperforms both VADER and TEXTBLOB in both conditions, with the largest accuracy gap observed in the "Emoji Tweets" category.
